254: [edit] A sukkah that is not at least 7x7 [tefachim] is invalid. Regarding the size, there is no maximum dimension.
[edit] If it is circular, it must be big enough to contain a 7x7 square.
[edit] If the sukkah is 7x7 and one places decorative garments in it and reduces the size to be below 7x7, it is invalid.

[edit] If one's head and most of their body are inside the sukkah and their table is outside the sukkah and they eat, it is as if they did not eat in the sukkah, even if it is a large sukkah. This is a decree due to the concern that they will be drawn towards the table.
